reviews.text: I can't recommend anyone better than this clinic for treating our pets. They are incredibly attentive, caring, and attentive, in addition to being excellent veterinarians. They work with great love and offer very good prices that allow us to treat our animals without breaking the monthly budget. I highly recommend them.

Fantastic vets who really love animals, and fantastic human beings. They have been of great help at all stages, when we just needed advice and when our dog was very sick. We are so grateful we found them.

Five stars for Dr. Patricia! She has cared for our two boys since they were little, with exemplary affection and professionalism. She is practical, direct, and very careful. Her love for animals is evident, and her humanity makes all the difference in her care. I recommend her without reservation!

This time I wasn't there as a customer, but as the mother of a daughter aspiring to study veterinary medicine. The kindness and promptness in welcoming my daughter were exceptional. Thank you for your attention and care 😊
The best. Don’t ever want to move from Matosinhos because of these two women.
There's no other clinic I trust more. Dr. Isabel is quick and accurate in her diagnoses, in addition to being very kind to the animals and giving invaluable practical advice! I highly recommend her!
Wonderful clinic, they treated my cat wonderfully well, impeccable service ❤️

Highly recommended clinic. Competent, ethical, and very humane professionals. They treat animals with care and with their well-being in mind.
I am very grateful to Dr. Isabel and her colleagues for taking care of my kitten.
Excellent service. I'll be a regular customer. Thank you.

Customer oriented service. The doctor is very attentive and nice, treats animals well.

Registered our cat in Portugal, did vaccinations, got European passport.
They're great with our best friends 🥰 …

🇺🇸Our good new friend and soon to be neighbor recommended this place to get our dog his Portuguese passport/ vaccination record established.
Due to the massive traffic jam in Porto for the university graduation ceremonies all around town we were running late.
It was no problem they completely understood and said they would wait for us.
Easy in and out and we met both doctors who wound up spending extra time with us discussing travel with our dog around Europe and other parts of Portugal and various vaccines we would need to stave of a variety of bugs that we would encounter.
We sent our USA based veterinary records to them via email, and we got a prompt reply that our little guy was set for a year.  So professional and warm Isabel and Patrice were. It’s a shame we Honestly won’t see them for a year, God willing.

🇵🇹Our new friend and future neighbor recommended this place to us so that our dog could receive a Portuguese passport and vaccination record.
Due to the huge traffic jam in Porto because of the city-wide university graduation ceremonies, we were running late.
There was no problem at all, they understood perfectly and said they would wait for us.
We got in and out easily and met the two doctors who ended up spending more time with us discussing our dog's travels around Europe and other parts of Portugal and the various vaccines we would need to avoid a variety of insects we would encounter.
We sent them our US veterinary records by email and received a quick response that our little one was ready for a year. Isabel and Patrice were so professional and warm. It's a shame we won't see them for a year, God willing.
